name: Divyang Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
benefit: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a disability of more than 40%. 1. The applicant must have a monthly income of up to ₹4,000/- or belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant must not be availing any other pension benefits.
